title: Ivo and the Bakery
author: Hazel Eastwick
blurb: Sebastian Crane, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
